purpose: Teach: 緒方/たたえ/東山/江口/徳永/関根/井出/新党

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、緒方刑事の現場対応も評価されますね
lines.en: Detective Ogata's on-site response has been getting good marks from the department.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, professional tone. Steady pace, even delivery. Recognition without fanfare—the voice of someone reporting procedure.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、市民の協力をたたえる感謝状を、警察、贈呈されますね
lines.en: The police are presenting a commendation to citizens for their cooperation in the case.
lines.style: Straightforward, official register. Clear articulation on the key terms. Even keel throughout—this is standard procedure being described.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、東山警察署と合同捜査されますね
lines.en: Higashiyama Police and our department are running the investigation together.
lines.style: Neutral, collaborative tone. Light emphasis on the partnership. Calm, informative pace—no drama, just facts.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、参考人江口氏から、警察、事情を伺われますね
lines.en: They're conducting interviews with witness Eguchi to get his account of events.
lines.style: Careful, respectful pacing. The register shifts slightly—witness interviews warrant precision and care in the telling.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、被害者徳永氏のご家族にも、警察、配慮されますね
lines.en: They're being considerate of the victim's family, Tokumasa and his relatives.
lines.style: Softer register, quieter respect. Slight slowdown on the family reference. The voice of someone acknowledging human cost amid procedure.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、目撃者関根氏の供述を、警察、整えられますね
lines.en: Witness Sekine's statement is being compiled and cross-referenced with other evidence.
lines.style: Technical, methodical tone. Steady pace. The speaker is describing careful investigative work—precise but not cold.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者井出の前科を、警察、確認されますね
lines.en: They've confirmed suspect Ide's prior convictions and are reviewing his criminal history.
lines.style: Direct, matter-of-fact. No hesitation on the suspect's name or record. Professional distance, but grounded in fact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、新党、つまり新党結成時の公安動向も把握されますね
lines.en: They're also monitoring the political situation—particularly any public security concerns from the new party's formation.
lines.style: Slight shift to confidential register. More measured, careful pacing on the political angle. The voice lowers fractionally—sensitive intelligence being shared.
